title: We drew monsters! Big scary ones!
scene: 问他和朋友今天干了啥。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did you and Sam do at school today?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: We drew monsters! Big scary ones!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Ooh, what did you do after drawing?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: And then we showed them to Ms. Lee!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Which monster did she like best?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Mine! It had three eyes and ten legs!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Ten legs? That's a lot of legs!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: And then it stomped all around the classroom!

variations: "drew monsters" 换 "built a fort"；"Ms. Lee" 换 "Mom"。
